title: Top Eight Match
next_chapter_hook: Lin Xiao coldly removed his left arm guard, revealing an ancient mark as black as ink—it was the 'Beast Soul Seal' lost for a thousand years from the Xuanwu Sect. The strength of the number one Outer Disciple far exceeded everyone's expectations.

text.content: That elderly gaze was like substantial force, firmly pinned to Chen Ji's back. His fingers holding the paper slip paused slightly, yet he didn't even turn his head, merely tucking the slip into his sleeve, the corner of his lips curving into an almost imperceptible arc. Third Elder, eh... arrived faster than anticipated. He silently calculated the time in his heart, the lingering resonance of the Tianji Record still echoing in his mind—those vague images told him that today's Top Eight Match would be far from simple.

The Martial Arena buzzed with voices. The Arena Platform for the Top Eight Match had been reinforced with multiple layers of formation arrays, the spiritual barrier shimmering with pale blue light. Among the crowd, there was no shortage of sneers and mockery. 'Look, that's废物 Chen Ji, actually making it to the Top Eight?' 'Heh heh, must be luck, all his opponents in previous rounds forfeited.' Chen Ji ignored them completely, walking slowly toward the Arena Platform, his cyan servant disciple robe fluttering violently in the wind.

A clear, melodious voice came from the other side of the Arena Platform. Chen Ji raised his eyes to see a tall, straight figure already standing on the platform—a young man dressed in white martial attire, with handsome features and an air of pride between his brows. It was Lin Xiao, the top contender for Outer Disciple number one, at the late Foundation Building stage, just one step away from Golden Core. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, the corner of his mouth slightly curling: 'I thought today's opponent would be somewhat presentable, never expected it would be you, this废物.'

Laughter erupted across the stands. The referee Elder frowned, sweeping his gaze across the arena, then said in a deep voice: 'Top Eight Match Second Round, Tianqing Sect Outer Disciple Lin Xiao versus Servant Disciple Chen Ji—begin!' The moment the words fell, Lin Xiao's figure flashed, turning into a phantom as he lunged directly at Chen Ji, his speed so fast that ordinary people couldn't react at all.

Chen Ji sneered in his heart. The Tianji Record's foresight ability had already allowed him to see through Lin Xiao's attack trajectory. He sidestepped, looking狼狈 but actually precisely evading the first strike. A flash of surprise crossed Lin Xiao's eyes, then his offensive became even more fierce—sword qi like a rainbow, every move lethal. First move, Chen Ji retreated three steps. Second move, he was forced back another five steps. Third move, a heavy fist slammed into his chest, sending his entire body flying, crashing heavily against the formation barrier.

'Cough!' A trace of blood seeped from Chen Ji's mouth, his face deathly pale. He pushed against the ground and slowly stood up, waves of intense pain radiating from his chest—his ribs were probably cracked in two. Shouts of exclamation and mockery came from below the platform: 'Hahaha, truly a废物, can't even block three moves!' 'Lin Xiao Senior Brother is mighty!' Lin Xiao stood with hands behind his back, looking down at Chen Ji from above: 'Concede. This level of resistance is utterly meaningless.'

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao's attacks were like a broken dam, Chen Ji had fallen into absolute disadvantage. The intense pain in his chest reminded him of the cruel reality of the gap in strength, yet the Tianji Record Fragment in his mind suddenly grew warm at this moment—

choices.text: Continue feigning weakness, wait for the opportunity
choices.description: On the surface barely holding on, actually secretly accumulating strength, waiting for Lin Xiao to reveal a flaw. Maintain the废物 persona, letting everyone continue to underestimate him.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the low-profile persona, don't expose yourself
choices.risk_hint: If Lin Xiao's offensive is too fierce, might not survive until the counterattack moment

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, revealing a weak bitter smile: 'Lin Senior Brother is indeed formidable... I concede...' Before he could finish, he suddenly felt a warm current surging from deep within his chest—that was the agitation of bloodline power. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly grew scalding hot, and the two forces produced a subtle resonance.

Chen Ji forcibly swallowed the second half of his words. He raised his head, a gleam of sharpness flickering in his eyes: 'Lin Senior Brother, I haven't conceded yet.' Lin Xiao frowned: 'Seeking death?'

choices.description: Activate the dormant bloodline before everyone's eyes, create resonance with the Tianji Record, forcibly break through the current realm.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the trump card, consume Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Break through on the spot, combat power skyrockets
choices.risk_hint: Bloodline power is unstable, may have side effects

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, the bloodline power dormant in his body for many years was finally activated at this moment. A scorching energy surged from the depths of his dantian, interweaving with the aura of the Tianji Record. Instantly, his momentum rose dramatically, his originally pallid complexion taking on a flush of red—the realm had forcibly broken through before everyone's eyes!

The atmosphere on the Arena Platform abruptly solidified. Chen Ji slowly straightened his waist, the intense pain in his chest seemingly suppressed in an instant by some force. The spiritual energy fluctuations around him began to surge violently, his originally tottering figure gradually steadying, even faintly exuding a sense of oppression.

dialogue.content: Lin Xiao, you asked for this.

text.content: Lin Xiao's pupils contracted sharply, he felt that sudden change. As the number one genius of the Outer Disciple, his perception of spiritual energy was extremely keen—Chen Ji's aura had actually broken through during combat? 'Impossible!' he exclaimed, his face showing the first signs of动摇. The audience below also fell into an uproar, everyone gazing at Chen Ji on the Arena Platform in disbelief.

Chen Ji rotated his wrist, the joints crackling like popping bamboo. He looked at Lin Xiao across from him, whose expression had changed dramatically, the corner of his mouth curving into a mocking arc: 'Lin Senior Brother just said something about废物not being worthy of standing on this platform? What about now?' Before the words even finished, Chen Ji pushed off with his toes, his entire person vanishing like a ghost. The next instant, he had already appeared before Lin Xiao, throwing a fist directly at his face!

Lin Xiao reacted extremely quickly, hastily raising his arm to block. Where fist met arm, a terrifying force instantly poured down, sending him sliding back several zhang, carving two deep grooves into the platform. 'What tremendous strength!' His heart lurched in shock—the right arm that had collided with Chen Ji was now completely numb,隐隐传来 bone fracture pain.

choice.prompt: The awakening of bloodline power gave Chen Ji the initiative, Lin Xiao was driven into a desperate situation. Now he had to make a decision—press the attack and completely overwhelm, or continue maintaining a low profile?

choices.description: Give Lin Xiao no chance to catch his breath, push through in one go and defeat him, thoroughly slap everyone's face.
choices.visible_reward: Completely defeat Lin Xiao, intimidate the entire audience
choices.risk_hint: Too flamboyant may attract more attention

text.content: Chen Ji gave Lin Xiao no time to react, his figure like lightning as he pressed forward. His offensive was like a violent storm, every fist and kick carrying a force that swept everything before it, forcing Lin Xiao to retreat repeatedly. 'Impossible! How do you possess this kind of power!' Lin Xiao's shock and anger intermingled, retreating continuously, yet never able to escape Chen Ji's offensive.

choices.text: Steady progress, advance strategically step by step
choices.description: Not rush for success, consume Lin Xiao with minimal cost, seek a one-strike kill opportunity.
choices.risk_hint: Lin Xiao may seize the opportunity to recover or use trump cards

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's mouth curved into a cold smile, his offensive undiminished, yet every move was perfectly measured—both able to pressure Lin Xiao and not give him any chance to counterattack. He was waiting, waiting for Lin Xiao to reveal a fatal flaw. The audience gradually saw the pattern—the initiative of this battle had completely changed hands.

On the Arena Platform, the tide of attack and defense had completely reversed. Chen Ji's figure was like a ghost, shuttling不定 around Lin Xiao, every fist landing with the force of a thousand jun. Lin Xiao was now in a state of utter狼狈, his white martial attire covered in dust and blood, his handsome features mottled with bruises—where was there any trace of his former arrogant demeanor?

dialogue.content: Lin Senior Brother, you just said废物don't deserve to stand on this Arena Platform?

text.content: Chen Ji kicked Lin Xiao in the abdomen, sending his entire body flying out, crashing heavily at the edge of the platform. He walked forward slowly, looking down at the fallen Lin Xiao from above, his voice calm yet carrying bone-penetrating coldness: 'Now then? Do you think you're worthy?' Lin Xiao clutched his abdomen, his expression ashen, his eyes filled with humiliation and unwillingness.

Lin Xiao suddenly let out a roar, his left arm violently shaking, his sleeve exploding apart to reveal an ancient mark on his arm as black as ink. That mark emanated rich demonic energy, making everyone present feel a pang of heart palpitations. 'That's... Beast Soul Seal!' someone exclaimed, 'The forbidden technique lost for a thousand years from the Xuanwu Sect!' Lin Xiao grinned savagely, his aura beginning to surge madly, his entire person seemingly transforming into a primordial fierce beast.

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao revealed his true trump card—Beast Soul Seal. His strength surged under the forbidden technique's enhancement, the situation reversed once more. Faced with this sudden turn of events, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Direct confrontation, break force with force
choices.description: Rely on the just-awakened bloodline power to directly face off against Lin Xiao using the forbidden technique. Crush his trump card with absolute strength.
choices.risk_hint: Forbidden technique's power is unknown, may have risks

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned cold, the bloodline power in his body instantly boiling. A layer of pale golden light shimmered over him—that was the unique characteristic of the Chen family bloodline. 'Since you want to play, let's play big.' He pushed off with his foot, his entire person turning into a golden stream of light, charging directly toward Lin Xiao. Fist light and Beast Soul power collided in mid-air, erupting into earth-shaking thunder!

choices.text: Retreat to advance, lure the enemy deep
choices.description: Pretend to be unable to match and retreat, actually lure Lin Xiao to expend more forbidden technique power, wait for the moment of the forbidden technique's backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Defeat the enemy without fighting, use the forbidden technique's backlash to defeat Lin Xiao
choices.risk_hint: Need precise timing, otherwise might be killed in return

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, his figure rapidly retreating, evading Lin Xiao's edge. He deliberately exposed a flaw, tempting Lin Xiao to pursue. 'Trying to run?' Lin Xiao roared, Beast Soul power surging forth, launching a frantic pursuit of Chen Ji. But he didn't notice that as the forbidden technique continued to be used, the Beast Soul Seal on his arm was constantly eroding his meridians.

Golden and black light continuously collided above the Arena Platform, erupting into earth-shaking booms. Chen Ji grew more valiant with each exchange, bloodline power flowing endlessly, breaking down Lin Xiao's offensive one by one. And though Lin Xiao had temporarily enhanced his strength with the Beast Soul Seal, he actually couldn't gain any advantage against Chen Ji, instead being beaten back step by step by the latter's fierce counterattacks.

'Impossible! How can my Beast Soul Seal lose!' Lin Xiao was going mad, his eyes crimson red. His body began to show abnormalities,诡异肿包 continuously appearing beneath his skin, as if something was frantically writhing inside his body. The backlash of the forbidden technique had finally begun. Chen Ji coldly watched all this, the corner of his mouth curving into a mocking arc: 'This is exactly what I've been waiting for.'

Chen Ji's figure flashed, appearing before Lin Xiao. He gave the opponent no chance to react, slapping a palm directly onto Lin Xiao's chest, directly shattering Lin Xiao's heart pulse while completely sealing the Beast Soul Seal power within his body. 'Bang!' Lin Xiao's entire person flew backward like a kite with cut strings, crashing heavily below the platform, blood spurting from his mouth, never to rise again. The referee Elder froze for a moment, then announced loudly: 'Top Eight Match Second Round—Chen Ji wins!'

The entire venue erupted in uproar! No one had expected that Chen Ji, originally considered certain to lose, would reverse and win, and in such a crushing manner. Those who had previously mocked Chen Ji now had faces ashen, unable to utter a single word. And in the distant tower above, the Third Elder's gaze grew increasingly gloomy—the bloodline power Chen Ji displayed clearly exceeded his expectations.

Among the crowd, a black-clothed figure silently observed all of this. The corner of Ye Qing's mouth curved into a playful arc—Chen Ji's performance exceeded her expectations. On the Arena Platform, Chen Ji slowly walked down from the platform, his face still pallid, yet his eyes flickering with profound light. The bloodline power in his chest still微微躁动, reminding him that today's battle had exposed too much. But he didn't regret—because the true chess game had just begun.

The moment Chen Ji walked down from the platform, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly grew slightly warm. He nonchalantly grasped the fragment in his hand, a line of vague text appearing in his mind: 'Top Four Summit, Beast Soul's Source, the gears of fate have begun to turn...' Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly—his opponent in the Top Four Match was actually related to Beast Soul. And in the distant tower above, the Third Elder finally withdrew his gaze, turning and vanishing into the shadows.
